run_preprocess_relaxed_cli: run the CLI to preprocess relaxed trajectory files into LMDB graph feature databases for S2EF task splits
run_write_images_to_lmdb: run the write_images_to_lmdb function to convert ASE trajectory files into pickled graph objects stored in LMDB
run_main_preprocess: run the main function to chunk trajectory files across workers and extract graph features into LMDB databases
refactor_write_images_to_lmdb: refactor write_images_to_lmdb to support configurable LMDB map size or different pickle protocols
